note: In the ledger, `sources` holds indices into `sources` below, and method fields hold indices into `methods`.
methods: Keep every stored field byte-for-byte in the JSON serialization when an identity, scope, parent, point, source-access or continuity gate is unresolved. No count is inferred from a parent, namesake, density, old unknown-year count or Wikidata population. Unresolved baseline keys have no population edits and no classification event is manufactured. Bind the literal own item and P31 settlement scope, exact full official BUA name, original point strictly inside its valid unrounded polygon and a single official county, and own active P131 chain to the row county. Check type/type_local/parent_id, reject suburbs, townlands, administrative cities, combined-unit components, duplicate candidate keys and unresolved identity keys. Join Census 2022 SAPS by both GEOGID and GUID and name; use T1_1AGETT total persons, not another geography. No fuzzy name or nearest-boundary substitution. No town-level annual estimate is substituted for Census 2022.

Bind the literal own item and P31 settlement scope, exact full official BUA name, original point strictly inside its valid unrounded polygon and a single official county, and own active P131 chain to the row county. Check type/type_local/parent_id, reject suburbs, townlands, administrative cities, combined-unit components, duplicate candidate keys and unresolved identity keys. Join Census 2022 SAPS by both GEOGID and GUID and name; use T1_1AGETT total persons, not another geography. No fuzzy name or nearest-boundary substitution. No town-level annual estimate is substituted for Census 2022.

Keep every stored field byte-for-byte in the JSON serialization when an identity, scope, parent, point, source-access or continuity gate is unresolved. No count is inferred from a parent, namesake, density, old unknown-year count or Wikidata population. Unresolved baseline keys have no population edits and no classification event is manufactured. Identity screening only with retained own Wikidata P31/P131, row scope and 2026 official UR polygons and 2025 region geometry; invalid polygons never repaired. Latest 2025 urban-rural SDMX population responses are HTTP 401, so every NZ population is held. The acquired 2025 workbook provides regional and territorial-authority counts, which cannot stand in for urban areas. A same-name SA2 never proves same suburb boundary.
